questions.question: Pearl Towers is taller than Sky Towers but shorter than Unity Towers. Unity Towers and Cyber Towers are of the same height. Pearl Towers is shorter than Indus Towers. Among the aforementioned buildings, which is the second shortest?
questions.solution:
Pearl Towers is taller than Sky Towers but shorter than Unity Towers,

**Unity Towers > Pearl Towers > Sky Towers**

Unity Towers and Cyber Towers are of the same height,

**Unity Towers = Cyber Towers**

Pearl Towers is shorter than Indus Towers,

**Pearl Towers Indus Tower > Pearl Towers > Sky Towers**

Or

**Indus Tower > Cyber Towers = Unity Towers > Pearl Towers > Sky Towers**

Hence, in both cases, 'Pearl Towers' will be the second shortest.

questions.question:
In each of the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

All cups are plate.

No plate is a shop.

**Conclusions: **

(I). No cup is a shop.

(II). No shop is a plate.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram for the given statements is as follow,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc04ce3550a29084db549633478aeb22fb675cae6bf01d92977ec0de89b6e03c.png] 

(I). No cup is a shop → true.

(II). No shop is a plate → true.

Hence, both given conclusions follow.

questions.question: Present age of A is 2 times the present age of B. After 8 years the B's age will be 4 times of C's present age. If C celebrated his fifth birthday 9 years ago, then what is the present age (in years) of A?
questions.solution:
Present age of A = 2B (twice of B, given)

If C celebrated his fifth birthday 9 years ago, (given)

→ Present age of C = 9 + 5 = 14 years

(B + 8) = 4 × 14 (present age of C)

→ B + 8 = 56

→ B = 48 years

Present age of A = 2 × 48 = 96 years

Hence, the present age od A is 96 years.
